executive-summary.overview: PromptBuilder is a Next.js 16 full-stack prompt engineering platform supporting Claude and Gemini providers, 14 prompting techniques, multi-agent swarm configuration, version history, and encrypted API key storage. The codebase is well-structured but has several security, robustness, and accessibility gaps.

critical-findings.finding: No input validation on most API routes (only /api/prompts/import uses Zod)
Gemini validateCredentials sends string instead of Contents array - crashes silently
PBKDF2 iterations at 100,000 - below current OWASP recommendation of 600,000
JSON.parse without try-catch in prompt-detail.tsx can crash the UI
Playground saves stale results (uses old results array due to closure)
Tag update in PUT /api/prompts/[id] is not atomic - delete + create without transaction
No delete confirmation dialogs anywhere - data loss risk

commit-1.title: Frontend Fixes: Accessibility, UX, Error Handling

issue.description: Navigation links lack aria-current="page" for active state; toggle button has no aria-label or aria-expanded
issue.fix: Add aria-current="page" on active links; add aria-label and aria-expanded on sidebar toggle

issue.description: Theme toggle button has no accessible label
issue.fix: Add aria-label="Toggle theme"

issue.description: Show/hide password buttons lack accessible labels
issue.fix: Add aria-label="Show/Hide API key" on eye toggle buttons

issue.description: Tag insertion buttons have no title or aria-label explaining their purpose
issue.fix: Add title attributes describing what each tag does

issue.description: Modal container lacks role="dialog" and aria-modal="true"; no auto-focus on title input
issue.fix: Add role, aria-modal, aria-labelledby; add autoFocus on title input

issue.description: Reset button immediately clears all work with no confirmation
issue.fix: Add window.confirm() before calling reset()

issue.description: No AbortController for fetch; no error state display; delete has no confirmation
issue.fix: Add AbortController cleanup; add error state; add confirm() before delete

issue.description: JSON.parse(prompt.structured) can throw; export has no error handling; delete has no confirmation
issue.fix: Wrap JSON.parse in try-catch; wrap export in try-catch; add confirm() on delete

issue.description: No AbortController or timeout for streaming; XML extraction regex too rigid
issue.fix: Add AbortController with 30s timeout; broaden XML extraction pattern

issue.description: No AbortController for model fetch; validation status persists after key change
issue.fix: Add AbortController cleanup; reset validation on key change

issue.description: Test result save uses stale results array from closure (results is old when promise resolves)
issue.fix: Save results from the newly created array, not the stale closure variable

issue.description: chatMessages array can grow unbounded; no persist middleware for draft autosave
issue.fix: Limit chatMessages to 100; add persist middleware for draft recovery

commit-2.title: Backend Fixes: Validation, Pagination, Error Handling, Security

issue.description: Missing centralized Zod schemas for all API request bodies
issue.fix: Create shared validation schemas used by all API routes

issue.description: No input validation; provider not checked against valid names; no message limit
issue.fix: Add Zod schema; validate provider; limit messages to 50; cap maxTokens

issue.description: No input validation; provider cast without check
issue.fix: Add Zod schema with provider enum validation

issue.description: Provider param cast as ProviderName without validation
issue.fix: Validate provider param against known names; return 400 for unknown

issue.description: POST has no validation; GET has no pagination
issue.fix: Add Zod schema for POST; add limit/offset pagination for GET

issue.description: PUT has no validation; tag operations not atomic
issue.fix: Add Zod schema; wrap tag update in Prisma transaction

issue.description: POST has no validation
issue.fix: Add Zod schema for template creation

issue.description: No validation; no promptId existence check
issue.fix: Add Zod schema; verify prompt exists before creating result

issue.description: validateCredentials passes "hi" as string instead of Contents array format
issue.fix: Pass contents as proper array with parts structure

issue.description: Model lists duplicated in providers and provider-factory (3 copies)
issue.fix: Delegate getModels() to getStaticModels() from provider-factory

issue.description: PBKDF2 uses 100,000 iterations; OWASP 2023 recommends 600,000 for SHA-256
issue.fix: Increase to 600,000 iterations; add security limitation comment

issue.description: Missing indexes on PromptVersion.createdAt and TestResult.createdAt for time-based queries
issue.fix: Add @@index([createdAt]) to both models

issue.description: unescapeXml double-processes when called on already-unescaped extractTag results; no fallback on parse errors
issue.fix: Document regex limitations; add fallback for parse errors; note unescaping behavior

recommendations.recommendation: Add rate limiting to AI chat endpoint to prevent API key abuse
Consider server-side API key storage (encrypted in DB) instead of client-side localStorage
Add CSP headers in next.config.ts for XSS protection
Add request ID logging for API route debugging
Consider migrating XML parser to a proper SAX/DOM parser for complex prompts
Add E2E tests with Playwright for critical workflows
